beats.intent: Ground and the character arrive, standing

board.end: Ground line and the character standing upright
board.why: introduce the actor before asking it to act

beats.intent: Waiting: breathing moving hold with one blink

board.end: Character breathing in a moving hold, one blink done
board.why: a living hold sets up the surprise that follows

beats.intent: A bubble pops; eyes lead, head and torso follow

board.end: Bubble popped at the right, eyes turned to it before the head and torso
board.why: the cause (the bubble) appears first, then the eyes react to it

beats.intent: Glance away (subtle), hold 0.3 s, snap back stronger

board.end: Character glanced away, held, then snapped back stronger
board.why: the second look is bigger than the first, which is what sells it

beats.intent: Crouch, arms up, settle, then the 1.2 s closing hold

board.start: Character looking at the bubble, upright
board.end: Character crouched, arms up, settled in the closing pose
text: Holds of 0.3 to 0.5 s between the beats
board.why: the reaction releases the tension and holds still for the 1.2s
